Working in games retail for a large chain in the UK, lets say their main product was music and they've been in the news recently.. Games were on the first floor (the entire first floor) and we had a small staff that handled the products on the shop floor (stacking, pricing etc) and we often had products that were mis-priced or mis-labeled just because we couldn't process the sheer amount of stock in the store. The manager always works on the ground floor, in fact he probably ventured into the games department 10 times in my year and a half contract, so we had a supervisor, lets call him Sidney, who handled all managerial complaints on our floor.

Right, onto the story.

A customer bought a game, totally happy, and left. He returned 15 minutes later and started browsing the preowned games again. He quickly comes over to the till with the game he just purchased and...another copy of the same game. Straight away, I knew what his complaint was going to be, "the prices are different, give me a refund". That's exactly what happened, but he was INCREDIBLY aggressive about it. Slamming his games on the counter, shouting at me and almost shoving cases in my face to show me the price. Now, Sidney has been observing this whole thing and comes over, takes the price sticker off the box and says to the man "sorry, but I'm taking this product off the shelves as it has been mispriced." and starts walking away (to try and draw the man away from the counter so I could serve other customers).

They weren't very far away from the counter and I will admit, I was paying more attention to their discussion than the customers I was serving at the time. The man started shouting at Sidney saying "you cannot do this, I'm going to report you to Trading Standards, this is outrageous etc". Sidney is handling the situation incredibly well, explaining that it says on the back of every receipt that any product can be withdrawn from sale at any time and he is completely allowed to do so. He never once raised his voice and treated the man with far more respect than I thought he deserved.

Typically the man then asks to speaks to the manager, to which Sidney happily obliges and fetches him from downstairs. Meanwhile the man comes over and starts bitching to me about Sidney, saying incredibly mean and untrue things not realising that I had just witnessed the entire thing. Before I can say anything, the manager approaches and hears the mans side of the story, which as usual is completely untrue and blown out of proportion. So the manager gives him a refund of the amount (about £3 onto a credit card..) and bitches Sidney out for pissing off a customer. Fuck my old manager and much love to Sidney.

tl;dr - dickhead customer tries to claim he paid too much for a game, supervisor removes the cheaper game from sale and gets bitched out by the customer, supervisor is incredibly calm and keeps denying the refund, customer asks for equally dickhead manager who gives the customer a £3 card refund and bitches supervisor out.
Bless the Supervisors, screw the Managers.
